🫏 New post ready 📚 List · nostalgia · 8 slides “what you taught me without ever saying a word” 📝 Slides
1. what you taught me without ever saying a word 2. how to share a warm bottle of soda from the cooler by leaving exactly two sips at the bottom. 3. staying on the cold basement stairs in silence when the kitchen upstairs got too loud. 4. that a broken yellow vase is just a mistake if we sweep the pieces under the rug before dark. 5. holding the heavy flashlight steady so i could climb the fence first, even when you wanted to go. 6. how to pretend to be fast asleep in the backseat at midnight so the grown-ups would carry us both inside. 7. that we could survive any long dinner by catching each other's eye across the crowded table. 8. save this for the cousin who still remembers the jokes we made up under the garden table.
✍️ Caption
we spent our summers dusty, sunburnt, and looking for trouble. now we only see each other at the big family dinners once a year. but when we sit next to each other, the years disappear. save this for the cousin you grew up with.
